nebojsa-jankovic.name: Nebojsa Jankovic
nebojsa-jankovic.bio: I founded Heroic Rankings with desire to help other businesses increase their visibility and bring real customers. I love SEO and networking with people.
bioParagraphs_legacy: My journey into the world of SEO has been one of perseverance and self-discovery. I started from humble beginnings, juggling warehouse shifts and studying engineering, but I always had a hunger for more. Throughout my life, I've seen myself as a problem solver. To me, every problem is a puzzle first and a challenge second. This perspective has driven me to develop a keen eye for detail and a meticulous approach, which has earned me the reputation of being the go-to person for resolving SEO issues. Paired with my leadership skills and results-driven mindset, I view any task, no matter how monumental, as just another puzzle waiting to be solved. Through hard work and adaptability, I’ve built a career and a company I’m proud of, turning challenges into opportunities for success.
Name 3 of your personal traits:
Resilient, dedicated, and ambitious.
What I like to do in my spare time:

Spending time with my wife and son
Traveling the world
Staying up to date with the latest marketing trends
spareTimeBullets: Spending time with my wife and son
Staying up to date with the latest marketing trends

anastasija-jankovic.name: Anastasija Jankovic
anastasija-jankovic.bio: I am a co-founder at Heroic Rankings and our goal is to help you find easy wins and grow your website’s organic traffic with SEO and marketing strategies.
bioParagraphs_legacy: What do you like the most about your job?

I like being a human resources manager because it creates new opportunities for people by connecting their needs and talents with company demands and creating an environment where everyone can succeed.
What do you most like about working at Heroic Rankings?
Seeing how visions can be put into action and made a difference by a team of dedicated individuals is what drew me to work at Heroic Rankings.
Name 3 of your personal traits:
Resourceful, social, and analytic
What I like to do in my spare time:

Travel and explore new countries and cultures
Hanging out with my little family relaxes me even on my busiest days
Cook dishes, preferably full of spices and meat

stefan-cvetkovic.name: Stefan Cvetkovic
stefan-cvetkovic.bio: Stefan is a prolific writer, with his reach extending from business and tech content to scientific papers, poetry, and short stories. When not in the office, Stefan plays music, collects vinyl, and travels wherever his right index finger points on the globe.
bioParagraphs_legacy: What do you like the most about your job? And what do you most like about working at Heroic Rankings?

It’s one of the healthiest work environments that I’ve ever worked in. We’re a small company so we can all get to know each other pretty well. Also, I love being enabled to grow, learn, and give a shot at new things.
Name 3 of your personal traits:
Patient, adaptable, and creative.
What do you like to do in your spare time:
In my spare time, I produce music, DJ, collect vinyl, and write. Also, I grab every possible opportunity to travel and soak in cultures from different parts of the world.

srdjan-gombar.name: Srdjan Gombar
bioParagraphs_legacy: What do you like the most about your job?

I love the fact that my work is always creative. Even when it’s a topic that was written and rewritten time and time again, there’s always a new spin or angle from which to approach it. Think about it: even in high literature, it’s not like you can invent a new genre or theme (even Hamlet wasn’t the first revenge story). You can just give it your personal stamp and hope it resonates well with the target audience. If anything, creating a new angle on something so many have covered so far is a challenge, and I, for one, love it.
What do you most like about working at Heroic Rankings?
The people. The process of creating SEO results is similar across enterprises, but people at Heroic Rankings are some of my favorite co-workers.
Name 3 of your personal traits:
Creative, communicative, and amicable.
What I like to do in my spare time:
Hang out with my son and nephew.Play video games.Boxing.
